description: Make one of the signed-in user's QR codes open a different link at different times of day, with the same printed QR. For example a cafe menu: breakfast menu 07:00-11:00, lunch menu 11:00-16:00, dinner menu 16:00-23:00. Outside every time, the QR opens its normal link. Times are 24-hour HH:MM in India time unless a timezone is given. A time that ends before it starts runs overnight (22:00-02:00). If two times overlap, the first in the list wins. Up to 8 times. This replaces all of the code's times; send an empty list to switch times off. Get the id from my_qr_codes (it also shows the current times). Read the times and links back to the user before calling this.

id.description: The QR id (10 letters and numbers), from my_qr_codes or create_qr_code.

times.description: The times, in order. An empty list switches times off.

link.description: The link to open at these times.

name: set_qr_times
title: Open a different link at different times
